verdict.rationale: Gemini has an official Mac desktop app for use without a browser, and it documents an OS-level shortcut (Option + Space) that brings up the chat window. The evidence does not show the desktop app reading what is on screen. Screen help is documented only on Android, and the Computer Use API is a developer building block, so neither counts toward the desktop app. missing for 10: documented on-screen/screen-context access in the desktop app, Windows/other desktop OS coverage, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can use an official desktop app with OS-level shortcuts and access to what is on my screen

citations.quote: You can interact with Gemini, Google's AI assistant, directly from your Mac desktop.
you can also use the keyboard shortcut Option + Space to bring up the Gemini chat window after the app is installed and running
get help with writing, brainstorming, coding, and more, without needing to open a web browser.
